name: com.singtaa.onejs
description: JavaScript runtime for Unity UI Toolkit. Write UI with React and TypeScript, render natively through Unity's GPU-accelerated UI system.

samples.description: 2D particle engine showcase (fountain, click burst, pointer trail) packaged as a UI Cartridge. Drag the cartridge onto your JSRunner to extract the TSX component into your app.

A fake ARPG HUD built from the particle effects games actually ship: loot that attracts into a gold counter, ability cooldown flashes, XP-bar edge sparks, level-up confetti, and low-health embers. Packaged as a UI Cartridge.
